getting-started.title: Quick start
getting-started.desc: Everything you need to be up and running in 30 minutes.

articles.title: Create your account and set up your organization
articles.content:
## Create your account

1. Go to [app.esgflow.com/register](/register) and enter your work email.
2. Choose a password (min. 8 characters, 1 uppercase, 1 digit).
3. Check your email and click the confirmation link.

## Set up your organization

On first access, the onboarding wizard guides you through 4 steps:
- **Business sector** — NAF / NACE code for sector benchmarking.
- **Headcount** — determines the applicable CSRD thresholds.
- **Geographic scope** — for regional indicators.
- **Frameworks** — select your target standards (CSRD, GRI, TCFD…).

> **Tip**: you can change these settings at any time in **Settings › Organization**.

articles.title: Import your first ESG data
articles.content:
## Accepted formats

- **CSV / Excel** (xlsx, xls) — columns: indicator, value, unit, period, source.
- **REST API** — endpoint `POST /api/v1/indicators/bulk`.
- **Native connectors** — SAP, Sage, Oracle (Business+ plan).

## CSV import procedure

1. Download the **CSV template** from *Data › Import*.
2. Fill in your data following the columns.
3. Drag the file into the drop zone.
4. Review the preview and fix any flagged errors.
5. Click **Validate import**.

Common errors: wrong decimal separator (use a dot `.`), dates in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), unrecognized units (check the unit library).

articles.title: Understand your ESG dashboard
articles.content:
## Anatomy of the executive dashboard

The dashboard presents three zones:

1. **Overall score /100** — weighted aggregate of the E, S, G pillars.
2. **Trends** — 12-month evolution, compared to the sector.
3. **AI alerts** — anomalies and priority recommendations.

## Understand your score

| Range | Level | Meaning |
|-------|--------|---------------|
| 80–100 | Leader | Exemplary ESG performance |
| 60–79 | Advanced | Good trajectory, a few areas to improve |
| 40–59 | Progressing | Corrective actions to initiate |
| < 40 | Beginner | Improvement plan recommended |

## Customize the weights

Go to **Settings › Methodology** to adjust the weighting of the E/S/G pillars according to your strategy.

carbon.title: Carbon Footprint & Scope 3
carbon.desc: Calculate your Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions according to the GHG Protocol.

articles.title: Difference between Scope 1, 2 and 3
articles.content:
## The three emission scopes

**Scope 1 — Direct emissions**: combustion in your own facilities and vehicles.

**Scope 2 — Indirect energy emissions**: purchased electricity, steam, heat.

**Scope 3 — Other indirect emissions** (15 GHG Protocol categories):
- *Upstream*: purchased goods & services, capital goods, business travel…
- *Downstream*: use of sold products, end of life, franchises…

> **CSRD note**: the directive requires reporting of Scopes 1, 2 and relevant Scope 3 categories.

## Built-in emission factors

ESGFlow embeds the ADEME database (France) and IEA factors for 80+ countries. They are updated automatically every quarter.

articles.title: Configure your SBTi decarbonization plan
articles.content:
## What is SBTi?

The *Science Based Targets* initiative (SBTi) enables companies to set emission reduction targets aligned with a +1.5 °C or +2 °C trajectory.

## In ESGFlow

1. Go to **Decarbonization › SBTi Plan**.
2. Set your **base year** and your **target horizon** (2030, 2050).
3. The tool automatically computes the required annual trajectory.
4. Add your **actions** (energy efficiency, green purchasing, mobility…) with their estimated impact.
5. Track progress in real time on the convergence chart.

csrd.title: CSRD Compliance & Reports
csrd.desc: Generate your ESRS, GRI, TCFD reports in one click.

articles.title: Generate your CSRD / ESRS report
articles.content:
## CSRD in brief

The Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) applies progressively from 2024. It requires the publication of sustainability information according to the ESRS standards.

## In ESGFlow — CSRD Report Builder

1. Go to **Reports › CSRD Builder**.
2. Select your **applicable ESRS** (auto-detected based on your sector and size).
3. Already-entered data is **pre-filled** automatically.
4. Complete the missing fields (flagged in orange).
5. Click **Generate report** — Word, PDF or XBRL iXBRL format.

## Certifiable audit trail

Each data point carries a SHA-256 timestamp and source → calculation → report traceability, ISAE 3000 compatible.

articles.title: Schedule automatic reports
articles.content:
## Scheduled reports

In **Reports › Scheduled reports**, configure:

- **Frequency**: monthly, quarterly, annual.
- **Format**: PDF, Excel, Word.
- **Recipients**: add stakeholders' emails.
- **Framework**: CSRD, GRI, TCFD, PRI or custom.

Reports are generated overnight (00:00 UTC) and sent by email with a secure download link valid for 30 days.

supply-chain.title: Supply Chain ESG
supply-chain.desc: Assess and manage the ESG performance of your suppliers.

articles.title: Send questionnaires to your suppliers
articles.content:
## Supply Chain module

ESGFlow lets you assess your suppliers across 6 ESG dimensions: environment, labor rights, ethics, diversity, governance, supply chain.

## Send a questionnaire

1. Go to **Supply Chain › Suppliers**.
2. Add your suppliers (CSV import or manual entry).
3. Select the questionnaire **template** (CSRD Tier 1, Duty of Vigilance, custom).
4. Click **Send** — the supplier receives a unique secure link.
5. Track responses and scores in the Supply Chain dashboard.

## Vigilance plan

In accordance with French law 2017-399 (Duty of Vigilance), the module automatically generates the vigilance plan with the identified corrective actions.

articles.title: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA)
articles.content:
## Why enable 2FA?

2FA adds a layer of security by requiring, in addition to your password, a 6-digit code generated by an app on your smartphone.

## Compatible apps

Google Authenticator, Authy, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden.

## Activation

1. Go to **Settings › Security**.
2. Click **Enable 2FA**.
3. Scan the QR code with your app.
4. Enter the displayed 6-digit code to confirm.
5. **Save your 8 backup codes** in a safe place (password manager).

> If you lose your phone, use a backup code to log in.

articles.title: Manage user roles and permissions
articles.content:
## Available roles

| Role | Rights |
|------|--------|
| **Admin** | Full access, user and billing management |
| **Manager** | Read + write on all data, no billing access |
| **Contributor** | Entry and editing of data within their scope only |
| **Viewer** | Read-only, export allowed |

## Invite a user

1. Go to **Settings › Users**.
2. Click **Invite**.
3. Enter the email and desired role.
4. The user receives an invitation email valid for 7 days.

api.title: API & Integrations
api.desc: Connect ESGFlow to your business tools via the REST API.

articles.title: API Authentication — Bearer Token
articles.content:
## Get your API key

1. Go to **Settings › Integrations › API**.
2. Click **Generate a new key**.
3. Copy the key — it will only be shown once.

## Usage

```http
GET /api/v1/indicators
Authorization: Bearer <your_api_key>
Content-Type: application/json
```

## Rate limits

| Plan | Calls / min | Calls / day |
|------|-------------|---------------|
| Starter | 60 | 10,000 |
| Business | 300 | 100,000 |
| Enterprise | Unlimited | Unlimited |

articles.title: Configure a webhook
articles.content:
## What are webhooks for?

Webhooks allow ESGFlow to notify your system in real time on events: new score calculated, report generated, alert triggered, etc.

## Configuration

1. Go to **Settings › Webhooks**.
2. Click **Add an endpoint**.
3. Enter your HTTPS URL (required).
4. Select the events to listen to.
5. Save — a signature secret is generated.

## Signature verification

Each call includes the `X-ESGFlow-Signature: sha256=<hmac>` header. Verify it server-side to secure your endpoint.

faqs.q: How long does it take to deploy the platform?
faqs.a: Go-live takes 2 to 3 business days. Our teams handle onboarding, indicator configuration and training your teams.

faqs.q: Is the platform really CSRD compliant?
faqs.a: Yes. ESGFlow includes all the ESRS indicators required by the CSRD. Our reports are audited by specialized firms and our audit trail is ISAE 3000 certifiable.

faqs.q: Can we import our data from Excel or ERP?
faqs.a: Absolutely. The platform accepts CSV/Excel imports and offers connectors to major ERPs (SAP, Oracle, Sage). Our RESTful API enables custom integrations.
All data is hosted in France, in ISO 27001-certified datacenters. We use no US cloud. GDPR compliance is guaranteed contractually.

faqs.q: What does the Supply Chain ESG module cover?
faqs.a: The module covers supplier assessment across 6 ESG dimensions, sending automated questionnaires, due diligence management and vigilance plan tracking in accordance with Law 2017-399.
No. The Starter and Business plans are commitment-free, cancellable at any time. Annual contracts get a 20% discount.

faqs.q: How does FEC import work for Scope 3?
faqs.a: Export your FEC from Sage, Cegid or Pennylane and import it directly into ESGFlow. The platform automatically analyzes your 60x/61x/62x accounts and calculates your Scope 3 emissions per expense category using ADEME emission factors.

faqs.q: How does the Validation Workflow work?
faqs.a: Each ESG entry goes through 3 steps: Draft → In review → Approved. Validators can approve or reject with a reason. Each action is automatically recorded in the Audit Trail with date, user and context.

faqs.q: What is the ESRS / Gap analysis?
faqs.a: This module compares your existing data and processes to the 82 requirements of the ESRS standards (E1 to G1). It automatically generates a gap analysis with a prioritized roadmap to reach CSRD compliance.
